title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཁི (Derge Tengyur, vol. 111)
shelf_note: Derge woodblock folio (margin foliation 319) from a Mahayana commentary in the dbu ma section, discussing the limbs of worship and quoting the Dasabhumika's great aspirations; belongs on the Tengyur shelf.

tr_errors_A.english: ...from the Chapter on Rejoicing in the Samadhiraja Sutra
tr_errors_A.problem: drops 'in verse, or' (the continuation of tshigs su bcad pa'am), so the alternative the source offers is lost

tr_errors_A.english: This aspiration is as extensive as the dharmadhatu, reaching the limits of space and the end of future time.
tr_errors_A.problem: the closing qualifier 'through all the counted appearances of buddhas across the counting of eons' is dropped from the second aspiration

tr_errors_A.english: Samadhiraja Sutra <gloss>... also known as the Moon Lamp Sutra</gloss>
tr_errors_A.problem: renders the Tibetan title 'Moon Lamp' by its other name; correct identification but not what the page says; the <meta> then calls it 'the Moon Lamp Sutra tradition'

tr_errors_A.english: The third great aspiration is to approach and make offerings in the presence of all the Buddhas...
tr_errors_A.problem: the sentence breaks off at the page end ('making offerings and'); A resolves it into a complete statement, which smooths over the page seam (content is correct)

tr_errors_B.english: going before the Teacher as he displays the great final nirvāṇa
tr_errors_B.problem: ston pa here is 'displaying' (going into the presence of those displaying parinirvana); B reads it both as 'the Teacher' and as 'displays'

tr_errors_B.english: the dedication found in the Vajradhvaja Sūtra
tr_errors_B.problem: Vajradhvaja is a chapter (dedication) of the Avatamsaka rather than a separate sutra; 'Sūtra' is added

other.note: stray '#' characters inside the transcription (e.g. 'རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོ་#རྣམ་པར', 'བལྟམ་#པ'), not on the print

pages.prefer_reason: Neither has a serious error, but B keeps 'in verse, or', the full qualifiers of each aspiration and the page-end break, while A compresses and drops a clause.

book_verdict: Clean Derge folio: the transcription matches the print word for word apart from stray '#' marks, and both English versions are faithful; B is the closer, more complete rendering.
